verdict.rationale: dlt ships its own AI Harness of skills, rules and MCP servers that teaches coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or Codex to build production-grade pipelines. dlt's context offering claims to make AI assistants expert dlt developers across over 11,200 REST API sources. The agent drafts against the REST API source's declarative config, which covers endpoints, relationships, pagination and authentication, and the result ships with `dlthub deploy`. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the agent reads arbitrary API documentation to infer auth and pagination, a documented review step for AI-drafted code, and independent or hands-on corroboration that AI-drafted connectors work.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts a working connector from API documentation — auth, pagination, streams — that I review and ship

citations.quote: The dltHub AI Harness is a set of skills, rules, and MCP servers that teach a general-purpose coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex) how to build production-grade pipelines, deploy and run them on dltHub managed infrastructure.
we turn AI assistants into expert dlt pipeline developers across over 11,200 REST API data sources.
Using a declarative configuration, you can define: the API endpoints to pull data from, their relationships, how to handle pagination, authentication.
launches your coding agent ready to build your own source
Deploy your pipelines with a single `dlthub deploy` command.
